subject: types: use flags in types package to handle clip zero case (#47543)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent focusing on executor/expression/sessionctx/store/table behavior changes. The clip-negative-to-zero decision is moved from `StatementContext.ShouldClipToZero()` into `typectx.Flags` (`FlagClipNegativeToZero`) and is now propagated via `StmtCtx.TypeFlags()` (set in `ResetContextOfStmt` for INSERT/UPDATE/LOAD DATA/CREATE|ALTER, set for cop-context via `InitFromPBFlagAndTz`, and used by expression casts / virtual column filling). Mock coprocessor handlers now construct `StmtCtx` via `NewStmtCtx()` to preserve warning plumbing when `InitFromPBFlagAndTz` no longer rebuilds the type context. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness/semantics/consistency within the requested scope.
